title: correspondent
description: Someone the household corresponds with, declared the first time a document names them or written by the household (ADR-017 §10).

address.description: Where they are, as the household writes it.

website.description: Their website, as the household writes it.

phone.description: Their phone number, as the household writes it.

email.description: Their email address, as the household writes it.

topics.description: The topics the household corresponds with them about, by the ontology's id.
